How to play

  1. One fight. Knock the other fighter's health bar down to 0. You take turns: one card per turn.
  2. Tap a card to see it big. Attack cards: tap the big card to attack. Heal, Guard and Charge: tap yourself (your fighter glows). Tap the small card again to put it back.
  3. Attack deals damage. Heal restores health. Guard puts a shield on you that soaks up the next hit. Charge gives spirit (Common +5, Uncommon +8, Rare +10, Epic +15) plus a small bonus.
  4. Your deck has 15 cards, your hand 5. Playing a card does not draw a new one: the card goes back into your deck. After your 5th card you gather spirit: 5 new cards and +10 spirit.
  5. At the start you may swap up to 2 cards. The fighter who moves second starts with Guard 3.
  6. Spirit (the number on the right, 0–40): only Charge cards and a new hand give spirit. At 40 it glows and your signature button lights up. Tap it, then tap the big card: Fox Fire Fist / Light of Blade deals 15, ignores Guard, and empties the meter.
  7. Long fight? After 14 turns each, Fury: every attack deals +1, and +1 more every 2 turns.
  8. Card colour = rarity: gray Common, green Uncommon, blue Rare, purple Epic, orange Legendary. The small RYO / AOI badge shows whose card it is.
  9. Attacks rush in and clash with the other fighter; Heal, Guard and Charge play on your own side. Tap the board to fast-forward. Signature moves: the screen darkens and the camera moves in behind the fighter for the strike; tap to skip.
